title: Marc-André B Possible NDE 7144
content: I went out of my body; I saw my silver line that connected me to it. My parents were in the hospital room where I was in an incubator connected everywhere with all kinds of machines. My mother was crying and my father didn't say anything but held my mother in his arms. I turned, as if looking at the ceiling. I felt being pulled upward and I saw the light with big soft warmth that went through my being. I almost instantly found myself in a luminous place where everything was marvelous, where I felt much, much love, infinite knowledge and above all a learning of my previous and future lives. There were light beings around me, talking to me and I felt very good, with complete trust. At a certain moment, I realized that I was dead. I asked them and they answered 'YES, you are dead; I'm here to guide you'. I learned that in a previous life I had been a multiple healer and that I committed many errors. I chose to do this life again on the BLUE planet, in order to acquire altruism, forgiveness, and to better understand the suffering of living beings. I wanted to understand the negative aspects of humanity and to better be able to fight the evil powers at my return into the light. I wanted to rise higher into the light, in order to be able to heal from a distance, master time, and transfers into other dimensions. They explained everything to me, gave me my instructions. I thought about mother who was grieving and I reintegrated into my, at that moment dying, child body and came back to life by miracle. The doctors said that I should have died. I remember the main lines, as during all my life, I had flashes and experienced special things, which lead me to help other people. Lead me to intervene and to accompany people in terminal phase towards the Light, to help them cross it towards their God. To understand that I have natural gifts of clairvoyance, of healing, and that it is very important to love others and not to cause them sorrow, by talking without reflection, about what I say. That I can teach to other people tricks to be a better human. Today I'm using a stick of energy in order to give vibratory communication. I'm sharing my knowledge, which is always coming to me, to help those who believe when I talk to them. I'm also using certain techniques with my hands, which I never saw, nor read in any book, nor anybody doing the same thing on our planet. Those knowledge and practices come to me from elsewhere (versus the light and my previous lives) most possibly through my near death. But I have no tangible proofs about it. At last, I can practice them for a few years: since the era of the New Age. In my spare time I'm writing a book and/or a series of books about this subject.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'luminous place where everything was marvelous' with 'big soft warmth' going through his being.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He says beings 'gave me my instructions.' He reports a mission involving acquiring altruism/forgiveness, understanding suffering/negative aspects of humanity, 'fight the evil powers' and later help/guide terminal people toward the Light, plus healing/clairvoyance and teaching others 'tricks to be a better human.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: As a baby/child in a hospital incubator 'connected everywhere with all kinds of machines' and 'at that moment dying'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reports a 'silver line' (cord) and learning about 'previous and future lives' plus receiving 'instructions'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room, then pulled upward into light/warmth, then arrival in a luminous place with light beings/communication, then return after thinking of his mother.

unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'YES, you are dead; I'm here to guide you'. 'I chose to do this life again on the BLUE planet'.
